title: Mixed Sprint: Any Verb, Any Form
description: 24 verbs, each in a different form. Work out the type first, then the form — that's the real skill.

points.title: Mixed review
points.summary: Mixed review: All forms, shuffled — the most effective way to make them stick.
points.body:
**Why mixed practice works**
Recalling a form yourself (instead of choosing it) and having to work out *which* form a situation needs are the two things that make grammar stick. Mixing the forms forces exactly that.

- Read the cue (→ polite past, → humble …) and the situation.
- Say the sentence aloud before you type.
- Use the hint only when stuck — it counts as 'with hint' and the question comes back sooner.
